subject.title: feat: add private AWS workspace service

question: Should Crabbox core own this dedicated private AWS workspace API and ECS deployment as a first-class coordinator mode?
rationale: The PR adds a specialized deployment, route contract, and configuration surface beyond existing behavior; implementation quality and automated tests cannot determine whether that long-term product and operations commitment belongs in core.

options.title: Accept after proof and cleanup
options.body: Keep the new core mode after removing the changelog entry and proving the authenticated target-account lifecycle and security posture.

options.title: Externalize the dedicated service
options.body: Retain reusable provider capabilities in core while moving the specialized API and deployment contract outside this repository.

options.title: Pause the feature
options.body: Defer or close the PR if maintainers do not want Crabbox to own this specialized service surface.

recommendation.title: Accept after proof and cleanup
recommendation.body: Keep the new core mode after removing the changelog entry and proving the authenticated target-account lifecycle and security posture.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns most current-main history for the coordinator/provider architecture and its recent security and lifecycle policy.
